content_sections.heading: RGU Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
RGU Research Associate III Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Research Associate III Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for RGU Research Associate – III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate – III position at Rajiv Gandhi University is scheduled for 07 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they arrive at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate – III post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First Class Post Graduate Degree or Integrated Post Graduate Degree in Tribal Studies discipline, along with UGC NET in the relevant subject (Category II).

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Associate – III position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate – III post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate – III post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 54000 Per Month, plus an additional 9% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate – III post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate – III position announced by Rajiv Gandhi University.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for RGU Research Associate – III Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate – III post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Rajiv Gandhi University, Doimukh, Arunachal Pradesh. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies of relevant certificates, ID proof, and passport-size photographs to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position. The job type is specified as Contractual.
